tagline: Turn any Indian grievance into the right forum, a cited draft and a deadline in 1 minute, with safe human review.
disclaimer: This is legal information, not legal advice.
input_label: Describe your grievance in any language
input_placeholder: Describe what happened, dates, amounts, and actions taken...
privacy_notice: Aadhaar, PAN, phone numbers, and bank accounts are auto-redacted before any AI processing. Please do not type names or addresses.
safety_alert: Immediate Safety / Violence Threat Detected. Please contact emergency services immediately.
farmer_step1: Call toll-free helpline 14447 immediately to obtain an SMS docket ticket number.
farmer_step2: Upload geotagged crop loss photos via Crop Insurance Mobile App.
farmer_step3: Submit loss intimation with premium receipt to Bank branch or Agriculture Officer.
farmer_step4: Insurance company must appoint a joint loss assessment surveyor within 48 hours.
legalaid_handoff: Call NALSA 24/7 toll-free 15100 or book video consultation at tele-law.in.
msme_tax_notice: Section 43B(h) Income Tax Act: Delayed payments to MSMEs are disallowed as buyer tax deductions until actually paid.
